# Interaction Club

> We want you at our table. Interaction Club makes meeting people offline easier through thoughtfully matched small-group dinners and personal invitations.

Founded and built by Vivian Yang, a UC Berkeley mechanical engineering student. Website: https://www.interaction.club/. Public repository: https://github.com/billionairebumblebee/Interaction-Club-hackathon. Updated October 11, 2026; launch metrics are founder-reported as of October 10.

Finding an event is not the same as finding your people. Interaction Club coordinates the group and the plan rather than providing another event feed. Adults 18+ share availability, budgets, interests and table preferences. An organizer reviews compatible groups and sends a private invitation; guests accept or decline. Joining the matching pool does not guarantee a seat.

Hackathon-week results: 36 sign-ups; 237 initial company emails plus 10 follow-ups/replies; 10+ founder-led social posts; ~30k combined views and impressions across platforms, not unique people reached. The October 8 pilot dinner had four attendees including Vivian. A second dinner was postponed after too few confirmations during midterms.

Exploratory conversations involve six communities/organizations: Pear VC, Outsome (International Accelerator), Mox SF, V11, Yes SF / San Francisco Chamber of Commerce and Malaika Commons SF. These are conversations, not confirmed partnerships, endorsements, investment or revenue.

The first pilot was founder-hosted to test the experience. The intended scalable model is self-guided small community dinners, with managed coordination and optional facilitation for paying companies or community spaces. Food, catering and any venue charges are separately funded rather than deducted from the operations fee. This model and willingness to pay are commercial tests, not established unit economics.

The web workflow uses Next.js, React and TypeScript, private Vercel Blob records, secret-authenticated Google Sheets delivery, private dinner access, saved RSVPs and consent, calendar export and arrival-support actions. Matching suggestions are deterministic rules with human review. An external AI assistant supports founder operations; there is no integrated autonomous AI matchmaker or validated personality-compatibility score. Native apps, integrated messaging and scaled delivery remain future work.

## Privacy and safety

Private participant records, guest lists, invitation tokens, credentials and correspondence are not public project materials. The product does not perform identity verification or background checks. Dietary and accessibility details support host and venue review without guaranteeing accommodation. The pilot does not establish clinical loneliness reduction or lasting friendships.

- [Privacy](https://www.interaction.club/privacy): data handling.
- [Your data](https://www.interaction.club/data): participant data information.
- [Terms](https://www.interaction.club/terms): participation terms.
- [Safety](https://www.interaction.club/safety): meeting guidance.
